title: Wave Echo Cave · Area 11 · North barracks

sourceRecords.title: Area 11 · North barracks
read: Heat from a glowing brazier touches your face. Stone bunks line the walls, and a broken table has been piled against the eastern door.

The brazier's warmth sets this room apart from the colder passages. Bunks leave narrow spaces between them, and the broken table piled against the eastern door makes that exit a practical obstacle. You can inspect the barricade from this side before deciding whether to disturb it.

brief: Northern barracks: STONE BUNKS line walls, ONE GLOWING IRON BRAZIER lights and heats center. EAST door barricaded with wreck of wooden table. FIVE furry bugbears stationed here, rough gear, waiting rather than in fixed combat. CORPSES REMOVED: no zombies or ghouls. No gold or surrendered prisoners.
